title: Rei's voice
question: Which of these is Rei?

options.label: a. Low, cold and clipped
options.note: Design prompt: "A Japanese woman of forty-one, a sales manager. Native Japanese speaker. Medium-low voice, cool and clipped, crisp consonants, no warmth, speaks quickly and expects to be obeyed. Not husky, not breathy." Reference pitch about 260 Hz. Every line passed the reading check. Takes: seeds 404, 505 and 606 per line, picked by the check, then closeness to the reference (for the quiet line, the calmest take): ja1 606, ja2 505, English 505, 大丈夫です 606 with English 404.
